user.title: AdaptiveCharge
user.description: Give this charger a name, then choose how your net power is measured.

net_power.title: Net Power Sensor
net_power.description: Select the sensor that measures net grid power (positive = import, negative = export). Enable 'Invert' if your sensor uses reversed sign convention.

consumption_production.title: Consumption & Production Sensors
consumption_production.description: Select the sensors for house consumption and solar production.

charger.title: Charger Sensors
charger.description: Select sensors for EV power consumption and grid voltage.

vehicle.title: Vehicle Entities
vehicle.description: Select entities for vehicle presence, cable connection, current range, and optional battery energy sensors.

data_description.ev_battery_energy_sensor: Sensor showing the actual kWh stored in the EV battery (e.g. Tessie Energy remaining, TeslaMate usable_battery_level × capacity). Enables overhead tracking and improved capacity estimation.
data_description.ev_energy_added_sensor: Sensor showing session energy added as reported by the EV (e.g. Tessie Charge energy added). Used for diagnostics alongside the battery energy delta.

range.title: Charge Targets & Low-Power Protection
range.description: Configure charge buffer, range hysteresis, default charge limit, and low-power force-charge thresholds.

data.low_power_threshold_pct: Low Power SoC Threshold (%) — optional, 0 = disabled
data.low_power_forecast_threshold_kwh: Low Power Forecast Threshold (kWh) — optional, 0 = auto-only

data_description.charge_buffer: Extra percentage to add above the desired range as a safety margin.
data_description.range_hysteresis_pct: Prevents start/stop cycling by requiring the range to drop this much below the target before restarting. Must be ≤ buffer.
data_description.default_charge_limit: The charge limit percentage to reset to when the vehicle disconnects.
data_description.low_power_threshold_pct: Force-charge when battery SoC drops below this. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.low_power_forecast_threshold_kwh: Force-charge when today’s remaining solar forecast is below this value (kWh). 0 means auto-only (uses ratio-based calculation).
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Your EV battery capacity in kWh. Used for precise forecast evaluation. 0 = rely on auto-detection from the vehicle.

surplus_settings.title: Surplus Charging Thresholds & Current Limits
surplus_settings.description: Configure when surplus charging starts and stops, and the current range your charger supports.

data.surplus_start_threshold_a: Surplus Start Threshold (A) — minimum surplus current to start charging
data.surplus_stop_threshold_a: Surplus Stop Threshold (A) — surplus drops below this to stop
data.min_current_limit: Minimum Current (A) — lowest current your charger accepts
data.max_current_limit: Maximum Current (A) — highest current your charger supports

data_description.surplus_start_threshold_a: The charger turns on when available surplus exceeds this value. Must be ≥ stop threshold.
data_description.surplus_stop_threshold_a: The charger turns off when surplus drops below this value. Must be ≤ start threshold.
data_description.min_current_limit: The minimum charging current your charger hardware supports. Set to 0 to allow the controller to fully stop.
data_description.max_current_limit: The maximum charging current your charger hardware supports.

charge_window.title: Night Charging Window
charge_window.description: Set the start and end times for the night charging window. The 'Charge Tonight' switch activates charging at the start time and auto-resets at the end time.

solar_optional.title: Solar & Forecast Sensors
solar_optional.description: Optional. Select solar generation sensor(s) and/or forecast sensors to enable solar-aware charging decisions.

data_description.solar_sensors: One or more sensors reporting current solar power output (W or kW).
data_description.forecast_sensors: Sensors reporting remaining solar energy expected today in kWh (e.g. Solcast ‘remaining_today’).

actuators_optional.title: Charger Control Entities
actuators_optional.description: Optional. Select the entities used to control your charger. Without these, the integration operates in monitor-only mode.

data_description.charge_switch: Switch entity to start/stop the charger.
data_description.charge_current_number: Number entity to set the charge current (A).
data_description.charge_limit_number: Number entity to set the vehicle’s charge limit percentage.

additional_options.title: Additional Options
additional_options.description: Enable optional features. Utility meters track energy over time periods. Advanced settings let you fine-tune the controller.

data_description.enable_utility_meters: Creates daily/monthly/yearly energy tracking sensors for the energy charged.
data_description.show_advanced: Shows the advanced settings screen where you can tune timing and safety parameters.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.description: Fine-tune timing and safety parameters. These affect how quickly the controller reacts to changes in surplus power.

data_description.smoothing_window: Time window in seconds for the EMA (exponential moving average) filter that smooths power readings.
data_description.sample_interval: How often (in seconds) the controller evaluates power conditions.
data_description.solar_done_threshold: Solar output (W) below which the system considers solar production finished for the day.
data_description.solar_done_duration: How long (s) solar must stay below the threshold before declaring ‘solar done’.
data_description.start_delay: Seconds to wait after conditions are met before starting the charger.
data_description.stop_delay: Seconds to wait after conditions are lost before stopping the charger.
data_description.modulate_min_interval: Minimum seconds between current adjustment commands.
data_description.import_guard_threshold_w: Grid import power (W) that triggers the import guard safety mechanism.
data_description.import_guard_duration_s: How long (s) import must exceed the threshold before the guard activates.
data_description.expert_mode: ⚠️ Enables an additional screen with low-level controller tuning parameters. Only change these if you understand modulation rate limiting.

expert.title: ⚠️ Expert Mode — Controller Tuning
expert.description: These parameters control the modulation rate limiter that prevents charger flapping. Incorrect values may cause unstable charging behavior, grid import spikes, or charger hardware issues. Only change these if you understand how they interact.

data_description.max_step_a: Maximum current increase per modulation step. Higher = faster ramp-up but more aggressive. At 3-phase 230V, each A ≈ 690W.
data_description.hysteresis_up: Minimum surplus above the current setpoint needed to trigger an upward step. Lower = more responsive but more sensitive to noise. Default 0.2A ≈ 138W at 3-phase 230V.
data_description.hysteresis_down: Minimum deficit below the current setpoint needed to trigger a downward step. Higher = more conservative about reducing current. Default 1.0A ≈ 690W at 3-phase 230V.
data_description.settling_duration_s: Seconds to wait after each current change before allowing another adjustment. Prevents self-induced measurement feedback loops.
data_description.priority_bias_w: Bias power (W) for the 'prefer export' and 'prefer import' modes. Prefer-import: controller starts charging even when importing up to this many watts from the grid. Prefer-export: controller only starts charging when there is at least this much real surplus available. Default 500W. Raise to require more surplus (conservative); lower for a quicker response.

error.stop_exceeds_start: Stop threshold must be ≤ start threshold.
error.min_exceeds_max: Minimum current must be ≤ maximum current.

error.stop_exceeds_start: Stop threshold must be ≤ start threshold.
error.min_exceeds_max: Minimum current must be ≤ maximum current.
